Ex: The house looked grim and dreary in the faint damp rain.

eccentric

(adjective). lập dị

Ex: She was the classic eccentric old lady, living with a houseful of cats.

fad

(noun). mốt nhất thời

Ex: It's just a fad. It won't last.

figure

(noun). nhân vật

Ex: He was a well-known figure in London at that time.

insight

(noun). cái nhìn sâu sắc

Ex: There are many valuable insights in her book.

legacy

(noun). di sản

Ex: His influence on younger musicians is perhaps his greatest legacy.

pendulum

(noun). con lắc, sự thay đổi

Ex: As so often in education, the pendulum has swung back to the other extreme and testing is popular again.

prose

(noun). văn xuôi

Ex: I've always preferred reading prose to poetry.

recover

(verb). hồi phục

Ex: He has fully recovered from the shoulder surgery.

setting

(noun). khung cảnh

Ex: It was the perfect setting for a wonderful Christmas.

slightly

(adverb). nhỏ, không đáng kể

Ex: She earns slightly less than $100 000 a year.

aspect

(noun). Khía cạnh

Ex: The book aims to cover all aspects of city life.

elevate

(verb). Nâng cao

Ex: He elevated many of his friends to powerful positions within the government.

exaggerate

(verb). Phóng đại

Ex: The hotel was really filthy and I'm not exaggerating.

misunderstanding

(noun). hiểu nhầm

Ex: The meeting is a final chance to clear up any misunderstandings.

overestimate

(verb). Đánh giá cao quá mức

Ex: I overestimated and there was a lot of food left over after the party.

praise

(noun). Sự tán dương, sự ca ngợi

Ex: His teachers are full of praise for the progress he's making.

religious

(adjective). liên quan đến tôn giáo, sùng đạo

ex: Josh is religious, but there aren't many men who would claim to understand women

underestimate

(verb). đánh giá thấp

Ex: We underestimated the time it would take to get there.

literature

(noun). Văn chương, tài liệu

Ex: For most people, the desire to study literature begins with a love of reading.

criticise

(verb). chỉ trích

Ex: The decision was harshly criticised by environmental groups.

theme

(noun). chủ đề

Ex: Hot temperatures were a common theme over the past couple of weeks.

assert

(verb). khẳng định

Ex: She continued to assert that she was innocent.

corrupt

(adjective). đồi bại, mục nát

Ex: The whole system is inefficient and corrupt.

drawback

(noun). điểm hạn chế

Ex: This is the one major drawback of the new system.

ethical

(adjective). thuộc về đạo đức

Ex: Is it ethical to keep animals in zoos?

ethics

(noun). đạo đức

Ex: He began to question the ethics of his position.

exclude

(verb). Loại trừ

Ex: Try excluding fat from your diet.

fair

(adjective). hợp lí, công bằng

Ex: We wanted to resolve this matter in a way that would be fair to her.

fault

(noun). Lỗi lầm, sai phạm

Ex: Why should I say sorry when it's not my fault?

justify

(verb). biện minh, chứng minh là đúng

Ex: Her success had justified the faith her teachers had put in her.

literary

(adjective). mang tính văn chương

Ex: Her internationally acclaimed novel has won several literary prizes.

polarity

(noun). tính phân cực, sự khác biệt

Ex: The film is based on the polarity of the two main characters.

reversal

(noun). sự đảo ngược

Ex: The new figures suggest a reversal of the trend.

sustain

(verb). chịu đựng

Ex: She sustained multiple injuries in the accident.

moral

(adjective). thuộc về đạo đức

Ex: She felt she had a moral duty to look after her elderly parents.

criticism

(noun). chỉ trích

Ex: The plan has attracted criticism from consumer groups.

critic

(noun). nhà phê bình

Ex: The critics loved the movie.

controversial

(adjective). Gây tranh cãi

Ex: A controversial plan to build a new road has met with protests.

debate

(noun). Tranh luận

Ex: Many of these points were raised during the debate on prison reform.

praise

(verb). Khen ngợi, tán dương

Ex: He praised his team for their performance.

nature

(noun). bản chất

Ex: His work explores the nature of the mother-child relationship.

engaging

(adjective). hấp dẫn

Ex: He must have been a very engaging speaker, a charming man.

fellow

(adjective). bạn, đồng chí

Ex: We sometimes appear to care more for animals than for our fellow human beings.

genre

(noun). thể loại

Ex: Crime fiction is a genre which seems likely to stay with us for many years.

mainly

(adverb). chủ yếu

Ex: People come to libraries mainly to borrow books.

mystery

(noun). điều kì bí

Ex: It is one of the great unsolved mysteries of this century.

offer

(verb). Cung cấp

Ex: The hotel offers excellent facilities for families.

principle

(noun). Nguyên tắc, nguyên lí

Ex: She went on to explain the principles behind what she was doing.

rarely

(adverb). hiếm

Ex: The term is rarely used today.

thrilling

(adjective). ly kỳ

Ex: Don't miss next week's thrilling episode!

ultimately

(adverb). cuối cùng

Ex: A poor diet will ultimately lead to illness.

adventure

(noun). cuộc phiêu lưu

Ex: When you're a child, life is one big adventure.

attract

(verb). thu hút

Ex: This proposal has attracted a lot of interest.

character

(noun). nhân vật

Ex: He loves to draw and create his own cartoon characters.

commonly

(adverb). thường xuyên

Ex: This is one of the most commonly used methods.

flaw

(noun). Thiếu sót, sai lầm

Ex: The argument is full of fundamental flaws.

identity

(noun). tính đồng nhất

Ex: He feels a strong sense of identity with his fellow men.

integral

(adjective). cần thiết

Ex: Music is an integral part of the school's curriculum.

transcend

(verb). vượt quá, tốt hơn

Ex: His works by far transcend anything that has gone before.

truly

(adverb). đích thực, thực sự

Ex: The results are truly amazing.

claim

(verb). tuyên bố, cho là

Ex: She's not the saint that many have claimed her to be.

influential

(adjective). có tầm ảnh hưởng

Ex: She is one of the most influential figures in local politics.

capture

(verb). nắm bắt

Ex: The song captures the spirit of those times.

unique

(adjective). đặc biệt, độc nhất

Ex: Everyone's fingerprints are unique.

compliment

(verb). Khen ngợi, ca ngợi

Ex: She complimented him on his excellent German.

envy

(verb). ghen tỵ

Ex: She has always envied my success.

eventually

(adverb). Cuối cùng

Ex: It might take him ages but he'll do it eventually.

gain

(verb). đạt được, giành được

Ex: The country gained its independence ten years ago.

outshine

(verb). tỏa sáng hơn, vượt qua

Ex: He far outshone the rest of the class.

plague

(verb). làm khó khăn, làm phiền muộn

Ex: The children plagued him with questions all through lunch.

prepare

(verb). chuẩn bị

Ex: A hotel room is being prepared for them.

reflect

(verb). phản ánh, cho thấy bản chất của

Ex: Our newspaper aims to reflect the views of the local community.

regret

(verb). Tiếc nuối

Ex: If you don't do it now, you'll only regret it.

restore

(verb). phục hồi

Ex: The measures are intended to restore public confidence in the economy.

thrill

(noun). sự rùng mình, sự xúc động

Ex: Meeting him was a real thrill for me.

admire

(verb). ngưỡng mộ

Ex: Actually, I greatly admire and respect him

influence

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: His film is heavily influenced by other film-makers.

joke

(verb). Nói đùa

Ex: She was laughing and joking with the children.

encourage

(verb). khuyến khích

Ex: My parents have always encouraged me in my choice of career.

defence

(noun). sự bảo vệ, che chở

Ex: When her brother was criticized she leapt to his defence.

include

(verb). bao gồm

Ex: The bill includes tax and service.

attention

(noun). Sự chú ý

Ex: An article in the newspaper caught my attention.

exalt

(verb). Tâng bốc

Ex: He was exalted as a pillar of the community.

genius

(noun). thiên tài

Ex: You don't have to be a genius to see that they are in love!

proficient

(adjective). có kinh nghiệm

Ex: With practice, you should become proficient within six months.

technical

(adjective). thuộc mảng kỹ thuật

Ex: We offer free technical support for those buying our software.

ability

(noun). khả năng, năng lực

Ex: People with the disease may lose their ability to communicate.

deserve

(verb). xứng đáng

Ex: You deserve a rest after all that hard work.

recognition

(noun). sự công nhận

Ex: There is a general recognition of the urgent need for reform.

illustrate

(verb). Minh hoạ

Ex: He is showing these silent films to help illustrate his story of survival.

in terms of

(preposition). về, đối với

Ex: The job is great in terms of salary, but it has its disadvantages.

tragedy

(noun). bi kịch

Ex: Investigators are searching the wreckage of the plane to try to find the cause of the tragedy.

expression

(noun). sự biểu hiện

Ex: He describes drawing as a very personal form of artistic expression.
